hero.title: Thibaut Gendebien.
hero.lede: Finance, development and automation. A direct point of contact for your ERP projects, integrations and AI agents, working remotely.

about.title: Understand the business. Build the tools.
paragraphs: I’m Thibaut Gendebien, founder of TG Tech Consulting. My background combines a degree in business engineering, financial reporting automation at EY and NetSuite consulting at Deloitte.

Since 2019, I’ve worked independently with businesses on NetSuite and SuiteScript development, application integrations, training and support. My current work also covers Odoo, Claude or GPT integration, and agents and workflows built with Microsoft Copilot Studio.

privacy.intro: How TG Tech Consulting processes data collected via tgtechconsulting.com.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.body: TG Tech Consulting — to be completed with name, BCE/CBE, address, contact.

sections.title: Data collected
sections.body: Vercel Analytics (cookieless). On consent, Google Analytics 4. Temporary host-side technical logs.

sections.title: Purposes
sections.body: Audience measurement, content insight, abuse prevention. No commercial profiling, resale, or advertising.

sections.title: Legal bases
sections.body: Explicit consent for GA4 (GDPR 6.1.a). Legitimate interest for Vercel Analytics and logs (GDPR 6.1.f).

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Retention periods for analytics data and technical logs remain to be confirmed.

sections.title: Processors
sections.body: Vercel Inc. (US, standard contractual clauses). Google Ireland Ltd. (on consent).

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: Access, rectification, erasure, portability, objection, withdrawal. Complaint with the Belgian DPA.
